name: Fluent, Inc.
business_overview: Fluent, Inc. provides digital marketing services in the United States and internationally. The company offers customer acquisition services by operating digital marketing campaigns, through which the company connects its advertiser clients with consumers. It also provides performance campaigns, such as a trial subscription of a good or service, the submission of a registration form, and the installation of a mobile app; consumer data directly via direct mail, email, telephone, messaging, and other channels; programmatic data offerings; call solutions marketplace; and social media campaigns through Adparlor. It serves consumer brands; direct marketers; and agencies across a wide range of industries, such as media and entertainment, financial products and services, health and life sciences, retail and consumer, and staffing and recruitment. Fluent, Inc. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in New York, New York.

classification_meta.logic_summary: Provides digital marketing services connecting advertisers with consumers via performance campaigns.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** FLINT Corp.’s core energy-services operations are underpinned by a large, multi-year backlog driven by a wave of contract wins, providing extended revenue visibility and demonstrating resilient end-market demand. However, the external environment remains unsettled: lingering macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainty, energy-price volatility, and a tight labor market are compressing margins and elevating competitive pressure from well-capitalized peers. The share-price weakness reflects market skepticism that this robust book of business can be converted into profitable growth without erosion from execution risks.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership has concentrated on balance-sheet repair, notably completing a debt-to-equity conversion that stabilized the capital structure. Strategic priorities include tight cost controls and disciplined execution of the secured contract portfolio; first-quarter results were consistent with internal plans despite the choppy backdrop. While the strong contract capture speaks to capable commercial positioning, the persistent disconnect between the backlog and the stock’s valuation signals that the market is yet to build full confidence in management’s ability to protect margins and deliver on the long-cycle work amid ongoing cost and labor headwinds.

Share on Twitter Share on Facebook Share on LinkedIn Share on Stocktwits

Fluent, Inc. (NASDAQ:FLNT– Get Free Report) major shareholder Global Value Investment Corp. purchased 61,368 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Friday, June 12th. The stock was acquired at an average price of $2.75 per share, for a total transaction of $168,762.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider directly owned 3,151,044 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $8,665,371.
